description: This file defines the EmploymentStatusDao class, which provides data access methods for EmploymentStatus entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes functions for retrieving, saving, deleting, and searching employment status records, as well as supporting pagination and filtering.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusDao
classes.description: Provides database access methods specifically for EmploymentStatus entities, including CRUD operations and search functionalities with support for filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getEmploymentStatusById
methods.description: Retrieves an EmploymentStatus entity by its unique ID.

methods.name: getExistingEmploymentStatusIds
methods.description: Checks for existing employment statuses among a list of IDs.

methods.name: saveEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Persists an EmploymentStatus entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Deletes employment statuses by their IDs.

methods.name: searchEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Searches for employment statuses based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmploymentStatusPaginator
methods.description: Prepares a paginated query for employment status search with optional filtering by name.

methods.name: getSearchEmploymentStatusesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employment statuses matching the search filter.
